Privacy Policy

How we handle your personal information when you request a quote or contact us.

props.label: 1. Introduction
props.html:
Last updated: July 2026

Please note: this policy is a general template. Add your business email (and ABN if applicable) in the "Contact us" section, and remove this note before publishing.

1. Introduction

Campbelltown Landscapers ("we", "us", "our") respects your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, store and disclose your personal information, consistent with the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs) under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth).

2. What we collect

We collect the information you give us when you request a quote or contact us — typically your name, company (if any), email, phone number, suburb, and details about the work you need. We do not seek sensitive information.

3. How we collect it

We collect it directly from you — through our website quote form, by phone, by email, or during a site visit. Our hosting and form providers may process submissions on our behalf.

4. Why we use it

We use your information to respond to your enquiry, prepare and discuss quotes, schedule and carry out work, issue invoices, and keep in touch about your job. We do not sell your personal information.

5. Disclosure

We may share information with trusted parties who help us run the business — for example suppliers, or software providers that host our website, forms or invoicing — and require them to protect it and use it only for that purpose.

6. Storage and security

We take reasonable steps to protect your information from misuse, loss and unauthorised access, and retain it only as long as needed or as required by law.

7. Cookies and analytics

Our website may use cookies and basic analytics to understand how the site is used and improve it. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

8. Access and correction

You can ask to see the information we hold about you and ask us to correct it. Contact us using the details below and we'll respond within a reasonable time.

9. Complaints

If you have a concern about how we've handled your information, please contact us first. You may also contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC) at oaic.gov.au.

10. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The current version, with its "last updated" date, will always be on this page.

11. Contact us

To ask about this policy or your information, call 0457 897 659 or use our contact page. (Add your preferred privacy contact email here before publishing.)
